unique.name: 1401 Eddy St #2 (owner-rented condo, 8–9 unit building)
unique.hood: Western Addition · Eddy & Webster, ~4 blocks east of Alamo Square, near Fillmore St and Japantown; ~15–20 min drive to Dogpatch via Octavia/101
unique.allin: $4,800 on Zillow ($4,500 on HotPads) · covered garage parking listed; Zillow says all bills included
tags: Covered garage parking (confirm the space is assigned to #2)
Laundry in building, not in unit (one other listing says in-unit; confirm)
Renovated bath (2024), heat pump, lots of natural light
notes: A 588 sq ft 1BR/1BA condo the owner rents out directly, in a small 8–9 unit building at Eddy & Webster. It has covered garage parking, a dishwasher, a bathroom renovated in 2024, a heat pump and good natural light. Zillow says all bills are included and the unit comes partly furnished, so the effective cost is a bit lower than the sticker. The block is a short walk from Alamo Square, Fillmore St and Japantown, and it's close to the freeway for the drive to Dogpatch.

Prices don't agree: $4,800 on Zillow, $4,500 on HotPads, and an older Apartment List post for a top-floor unit in the same building shows $2,500 with an “assigned parking space included.” That price is far below market, so ignore it. Confirm the price, that a garage space is assigned to #2 and fits a Mazda 3, and whether laundry is shared. At 588 sq ft a desk plus a dining table will be tight. For a 1–2 year stay it's on the pricey side of happy, so it's worth seeing only if the parking and price check out.
scam: Some caution

the owner writes the listing in the first person and the building is real, but prices differ between sites and one copy shows a too-good $2,500. Tour in person and pay nothing before you've seen the unit and signed a lease.
unique.who: Individual owner (bought the condo ~4 years ago; not named)
